title: Spotify Playlist Version Control
description: Platform allowing users to save, preview, and reload versions of their Spotify playlists. Uses a SQL database and Python Flask backend to handle API calls, with a tree-like structure to track and efficiently retrieve version history.

title: HotKeys
description: Interactive visualization tool showing character frequencies and keystroke habits. Encodes data via a keyboard heatmap using D3 and Svelte, combining bigrams/trigrams with character trajectories to create meaningful user interactions.

title: GoPhoto
description: Full-stack platform connecting photographers and customers. Features SQL-backed user profiles, AWS photo storage, on-site messaging, Stripe payments, and separate client/photographer views — generating 20+ connections and $1000+ in revenue.
